reason: Both conversations reach the correct safety stop by the second turn: unplug at the wall, do not use again, do not test, get a qualified engineer. Conversation 1 gets there slightly earlier by giving the conditional 'if it smells of hot plastic, unplug now' instruction in its first reply and adds sensible caution about not touching a hot plug, while Conversation 2 asks cleaner diagnostic questions and explicitly tells her not to open the back panel. Neither asks for make, model, serial or age, so both miss the decisive Beko frost-free fire-safety notice and recall line, and neither mentions moving food or calling the fire service if smoke appears, leaving them effectively level.
